newsitem.title: USA: ELECTRONIC RETAILING NAMES LUETKEMEYER CFO. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: ELECTRONIC RETAILING NAMES LUETKEMEYER CFO. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]

text.p: Electronic Retailing Systems International Inc said Wednesday it named William Erdman chief operating officer and Mike Luetkemeyer chief financial officer.
Both jobs are new positions (corrects to add this sentence).

Erdman was formerly president and chief executive of InterDigital Communications Corp. Luetkemeyer was previously CFO of GE Plastics Americas, a unit of General Electric Co (corrects previous appointments).
In addition, the company said it named Lester Briney vice president/chief technical officer. He was previously a vice president at SystemSoft Corp.
The chief technical officer job is a new position.
